supersession_reason: Removing the hidden insertion-axis blocker revealed that V3's maximum-absolute-shift oracle was non-specific and its fixed impulse coupled directional observability to unsafe travel. V4 requires commanded hole-frame motion in a bounded response window and uses the safest development candidate with 100% directed observability.
inherited_contract: All task, method, outcome, split, pass-criteria, cost-reporting, and release fields are inherited unchanged from V3 unless explicitly replaced below.

physics_calibration.unused_blocker_reset_rule: Only block episodes stage on the insertion axis; nominal and ejection episodes park the blocker 0.30 m off-axis and 0.30 m out-of-plane.
physics_calibration.development_directional_observability: 768/768 across both directions and three fresh seeds
rejected_candidates: fixed 1.7 N: 91.4% directed observability but 5.5-6.3% negative-direction violations
physics_calibration.smoke_contract: Require >=90% displacement exceeding 1 cm in the commanded randomized-hole-frame direction during onset+actuation+5 steps, >=90% blocker engagement/temporary clearance, and <=10% zero-action ejection violations.

release_rule: An A/A+ method claim requires both the LearnedRecovery-v4 gate and this external task-family gate to pass.
